_doc: Installers the SYSTEM adopter applies by itself (ops/box/apply_installers.py, run from ops/box/box_selfheal.ps1 on every adoption). A row runs once per installer version (sha256), never for credentials or auth. principal 'system': the installer registers SYSTEM tasks and runs as it is. principal 'desk_user': the installer registers a task for the interactive desk account and must declare a -User parameter, which the applier fills from the auto-logon account; without one the row is refused. args: switches only.
